messages:
morgan: Quick scheduling question — our biweekly release that would normally ship on 2026-12-22 falls right into APAC end-of-year holidays. Can we move the bridge or swap owners? TL;DR: need a bridge cover + confirm cutoff remains Tues 16:00 PT. Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/releases/slot-23 :spiral_calendar:

release-bot: Reminder: cutoff-branch freeze scheduled Tue 2026-12-16 16:00 PT. See /release-checklist :bell:

shiv: I'm OOO from 12/21-12/27 but can do the bridge on 12/20 if we move it earlier. Otherwise happy to be backup on 12/22.

pm-jen: We prefer not to shift product freeze earlier — it impacts customer trials. Can we instead rotate bridge owners? @taylor any chance you can take the on-call bridge?

taylor: I can cover 12/22 but prefer morning slot. If we need an earlier bridge, I can do 12/20 AM.

devex-liz: Suggestion — keep cutoff as-is, run a light release (patch) Dec 22 with canary. If issues, auto-fallback to previous version. I can add a canary rollout ticket.

morgan: OK plan: keep cutoff Tue 12/16 16:00 PT. Can we do bridge on 12/22 09:00 PT and @taylor you lead, @shiv backup? @release-bot please add canary flag.

taylor: lgtm. I'll open the checklist PR and ping eng oncall. PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-checks/pull/412

shiv: leaving a note in the branch: bump version to v1.14.2 and add changelog blurb. cc @devex-liz

devex-liz: I'll drop a changelog nudge in the docs repo. Also adding the build matrix to avoid long seq lengths causing perf flakes.

morgan: checklist for bridge (paste) ```
- confirm cherry-picks merged
- run preflight smoke script: ./scripts/smoke.sh
- tag release: git tag -a v1.14.2 -m "release v1.14.2"
- enable canary: rollout=10%
- monitor latency & error rate for 30m
```

release-bot: Deploy job queued: jobs/release-v1.14.2 (ID 98765). Status: queued.

taylor: Quick Q — who is owner for changelog review? I can assemble notes but need product signoff.

pm-jen: I'll review changelog by EOD Mon 12/15. @taylor go ahead and draft.

shiv: pinging to remind to cut branch before Tue 12/16 09:00 PT if you need extra CI runs.

morgan: thanks all — summarizing: cutoff stays Tue 12/16 16:00 PT, bridge 12/22 09:00 PT led by taylor, shiv backup, canary rollout 10%, changelog and version bump v1.14.2. I'll update the release calendar.

taylor: ✅ I'll add the bridge event and invite leads.
